thread:
maya: Quick heads-up — planning public announcement for the v0.9 inference runtime update next Wed (2026-04-01). Need a final eng sign-off on the changelog text, canonical docs link, and canary timing. :rocket:
simon: I can review changelog today. What's the proposed canary size and regions?
maya: Thinking 5% global traffic for 48h, then 25% for another 24h if no regressions. Start US-West first, then EU, APAC last. Open to recs.
liam: 5% sounds safe. We should pin a fallback to the previous model variant and automatic rollback on error-rate > 1% or latency p95 spike > 200ms.
chloe: Marketing needs the docs permalink and a short changelog blurb we can drop into the blog and release post. Also want one benchmark callout for the announcement and a single-line webinar CTA.
simon: Draft changelog snippet below — please review: ```- Improved KV cache locality reducing p99 token latency by ~30ms.
- New quantization profile (q4_v2) that lowers per-token cost ~48% in our internal benchmarks.
- Canary and fallback support for mixed-model routing.```
maya: Nice. Can we make the second bullet safe to publish? Legal asked for "internal benchmarks" phrasing. So: "internal benchmarks showed ~48% per-token cost reduction vs baseline" — that ok?
simon: Fine. Replace the number with "~48%" and keep the internal qualifier.
chloe: For marketing headline/benchmark: "Up to 48% lower per-token cost in internal tests; latency improvements for long-context workloads." Good?
liam: Suggest a short technical note to accompany the benchmark in the docs: methodology, workload shape, sequence lengths, and model variant. Send me the draft and I'll sanity-check.
maya: Webinar: propose Tue 2pm PT (day after launch) — product + eng panel, short demo, Q&A. Chloe, can you run the RSVP flow? We'll route enterprise leads directly to sales (tag: release-v0.9) and dev trial requests to the growth SDR queue.
chloe: Yup. I'll set up a HubSpot form and Slack webhook to #sales-leads with tag release-v0.9. Any special fields?
maya: Add "expected token volume" and "use case" fields to help prioritize leads.
simon: Deploy/ops note: canary scheduled for 2026-04-01 10:00 PT for US-West. deploy-bot will post start/finish events. Make sure APM alerting is active for the canary pool.
deploy-bot: Canary job scheduled: start=1998832800 (2026-04-01T17:00Z), duration=172800s for initial window. Notifications: #eng-oncall, #eng-sre, #marketing.
liam: Also add a quick support playbook: how to triage model quality regressions (prompt set, eval harness link, rollback steps). I'll draft and attach to the docs.
maya: OK to publish docs link as soon as simon + liam confirm the short technical note. Chloe will hold the blog post until we have the QA checklist and webinar CTA.
simon: I've pushed the final changelog to the release branch and left a diff in the PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1422.
chloe: Draft blog + social copy in GDoc: https://docs.google.com/draft--v0.9 (will share perms). I'll include the benchmark one-liner and webinar registration link.
maya: Action items: simon (review/confirm short tech note + changelog by EOD), liam (draft support playbook + benchmark methodology by EOD), chloe (RSVP flow + blog draft, hold publish until all confirmations). I'll coordinate the webinar comms and lead routing. Ping me if anything slips. :thumbsup:
simon: Reviewing now, will update PR with the small wording change.
liam: Starting the playbook draft.
chloe: Setting up HubSpot form and Slack webhook. Will post final links here.
maya: Thanks team — aiming for smooth launch.
